vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-126190
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 4.0.0 can exhibit polynomial-time denial of service while matching descendant combinators against deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML.

statements.status_notes: The aedt and all extras include JupyterLab, which brings in SoupSieve transitively. The lock resolves SoupSieve 2.10 when python_full_version is below 3.11.5; this is within the advisory's affected range. This confirms dependency exposure, but not exploitability. Repository and deployment evidence has not established that deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML reaches descendant-combinator matching.
statements.action_statement: Determine whether untrusted HTML or XML reaches SoupSieve through the aedt or all extras. If it does, assess a Python-compatible backport, runtime support change, or other mitigation; update this statement with the evidence.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-6655-6qjp-jx7x
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions through 2.10 are affected by exponential regular-expression backtracking during selector compilation when processing a CSS escape sequence.

statements.status_notes: The aedt and all extras include JupyterLab, which brings in SoupSieve transitively. The lock resolves SoupSieve 2.10 when python_full_version is below 3.11.5; this version is within the reported affected range (<=2.10). Exploitability depends on whether an attacker-controlled selector reaches selector compilation, which has not been established for this product.
statements.action_statement: Determine whether attacker-controlled CSS selectors can reach SoupSieve through the aedt or all extras. If so, assess a Python-compatible backport, runtime support change, or other mitigation; update this statement with the evidence.

vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 2.10 can perform excessive work for certain :has() selectors containing the general sibling combinator.
